localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description:
Example images only — your cabin may vary in size, layout, and surroundings.

These brand-new cabins offer a cozy indoor sleeping area, covered outdoor space and one parking spot.

What to bring: Bedding and pillows, outdoor cooking equipment, dishes, chairs and small table for use on the covered outdoor deck.

Indoor space: 139 sq ft

  • Sleeps up to 5 guests (maximum 4 adults) with one single bed and a bunk bed (double lower bed, double upper bed).
  • Equipped with baseboard heat, lighting, an overhead fan, and one power outlet inside and one outside.
  • No cooking inside the cabin.
  • No smoking or vaping inside the cabin.
  • Pets are not allowed.

Covered outdoor deck: 95 sq ft

  • Bring your own outdoor cooking equipment, dishes, chairs and small table for use on the covered outdoor deck.
  • Picnic table provided outside.
  • No wood burning fire pits at Tribune Bay campground. Bring your own propane fire pit to be used outside of the cabin.
  • Water taps, pit toilets, and pay showers are available throughout the campground.
  • Includes one assigned vehicle parking spot; the maximum vehicle parking length is 20 feet long. No additional parking spots are available at this campground or elsewhere on the island.
  • Extra tents and sleeping structures are not permitted.
